description: Three terminal coding agents herdr runs, through their vendors' curl installers: Maki, Prime Agent and Oh My Pi.
why: Each agent has one witness here: ~/.local/bin/maki, ~/.local/bin/prime-agent, and ~/.omp, which omp writes when run. ~/.local/bin/omp and ~/.prime are on disk and claim nothing, so the Oh My Pi finding is ~/.omp's alone, and removing a value turns must_find red. Oh My Pi is a fork of Pi, so pi and openclaw are forbidden; claude-code and codex-cli because ~/.local/bin and top-level home directories are their routes too.
known_gaps: Maki's and Oh My Pi's Windows installers (install.ps1) are not exercised.
